messages:
david-oncall: noticing control-plane heartbeat silence in ap-south1. auth-proxy returning 503s, provisioner queue growing, GPU allocations failing. opening incident.

ops-bot: [automated] Ap-south1 controlplane: leader heartbeat missing for 45s, 2/5 replicas NotReady.

maya-sre: oncall here, collecting logs. can someone curl leader health?

sara-infra: running:
```
curl -sS https://controlplane.ap-south1.redwood.internal/health
```
response: 503 Service Unavailable

jordan-prod: provisioning alarms show GPU pool eviction events and OOMs on the provisioner. prewarmed nodes stuck at 0/4 ready.

maya-sre: disabling controlplane autoscaler to stop flapping: `kubectl patch hpa controlplane -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2,"maxReplicas":2}}'`

sara-infra: starting traffic shift: ap-south1 -> na-east1 10% -> 70% over 7m. will monitor latency and rate limits. :truck: 

jordan-prod: increasing dedicated GPU prewarm in na-east1 (adding 3 nodes), kicked off scale job.

david-oncall: for auth storms, enabling token-cache fallback TTL +60s in config. applying patch now.

deploy-bot: rollout triggered: controlplane-config rollback v2026.03.12 -> v2026.03.08 (reason: recent rollout correlated with heartbeat regressions). Rolling back canaries in ap-south1.

maya-sre: logs indicate config sync worker stuck on parsing large policy bundle; hitting CPU starvation on controlplane leader. pushing temporary RBAC throttle.

ops-bot: metric spike: controlplane cpu 95% -> dropping after rollback start.

sara-infra: traffic shift 70% complete, error rate for user auth down from 18% -> 3%.

jordan-prod: GPU allocations cleared, provisioner queue length dropping from 420 -> 12.

maya-sre: leader heartbeat restored at 2154321180, replicas stabilizing.

david-oncall: pausing traffic shift to let caches warm, keeping na-east1 at 60% for 10m. will not re-enable autoscaler until follow-up.

sara-infra: noted. scheduling brief emergency deploy freeze for ap-south1.

david-oncall: incident triage: probable root cause = recent controlplane config parsing path + bursty policy bundle leading to CPU exhaustion and missed heartbeats; secondary effect: provisioner backpressure causing GPU allocation delays. action items: postmortem + config linting, add resource limits to parser, add guardrails to provisioner queue size.

maya-sre: creating incident doc and assigning owners. postmortem meeting at 2154324600 (in 1h). I'll annotate signal graphs.

david-oncall: thank you all. marking issue as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
